## Limitations and threats to validity

- The Kimi K3 Claude Code run is excluded from every comparative result because the gateway most likely lowered `max` effort to `high` and did not pass earlier reasoning back to the model (@sec-measurement-corrections). Consequently, Kimi harness comparisons cover only Pi and Codex; OpenCode V2 was not run. The DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Claude Code results come from a CLIProxyAPI rerun that requested `max` effort and retained earlier reasoning; the two earlier Claude Code runs, which lacked one or both, are excluded. DeepSeek comparisons cover Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode V2, because the Pi condition lost its earlier reasoning in six of ten trials and could not be repeated [@pa1Issue102; @pa1Issue108; @pa1Issue111].
